title: Best AI Tools for Small Business 2026: 40+ Tools Tested and Reviewed

facts.fact: The guide reviews 40+ named AI tools across 9 categories, with real pricing.
facts.quote: 40+ named AI tools across 9 categories, with real pricing, who each tool is for, and (most importantly) when to avoid it.

facts.fact: The page states the typical small business AI tool stack in 2026 is 5 tools: one general LLM plus 4 workflow-specific tools.
facts.quote: The typical small business AI tool stack in 2026 is 5 tools: one general LLM plus 4 workflow-specific tools layered on top of existing software.

facts.fact: The page states that about $25 to $30 per user per month for a business-tier general LLM is the minimum acceptable spend.
facts.quote: About $25 to $30 per user per month for a business-tier general LLM is the minimum acceptable spend.

facts.fact: The page states that hidden costs (data prep, integration, training, rework) add 40 to 60 percent on top of visible spend in year one.
facts.quote: Hidden costs (data prep, integration, training, rework) add 40 to 60 percent on top of visible spend in year one.
